purpose.name: market research and quality assurance

purpose.name: debugging and security

purpose.name: marketing communications

purpose.text: To enhance and personalize our Service, products and our marketing efforts
purpose.name: enhancement and personalization

purpose.text: To develop and serve advertisements on our website or through e-mails or other communications
purpose.name: advertising

purpose.text: To conduct marketing research
purpose.name: market research

references.text: in accordance with the practices described in this Privacy Policy
